On Friday 3 June there will be an Intercity Number Theory Seminar at VU Amsterdam on the topic of formalization.

Program:
11:00 - 12:00 Anne Baanen (VU Amsterdam); Introduction to formalizing number theory
13:15 - 14:15 Manuel Eberl (Innsbruck); How to avoid bad points in contour integration, rigorously
14:30 - 15:30 Alex Best (VU Amsterdam); Formalization in number theory, past, present and future
16:00 - 17:00 Johan Commelin (Freiburg); Liquid Tensor Experiment

Talks will not be streamed/recorded. The main intended audience consists of (a wide variety of) number theorists having little to no experience with proof assistants/formalization. But anybody who happens to be in the neighbourhood :wink: is welcome to attend (no registration necessary).

For more info see: https://pub.math.leidenuniv.nl/~brightmj/ic/2022.html (scroll down)
